toast.repeatCount: Small muted counter after a notification's text when the same notification happened again while it was still on screen, for example ×3. Keep it as short as the source

avatar.more_one: Screen reader text for the +1 chip at the end of a row of overlapping profile pictures. It says how many people are not shown.
avatar.more_other: Screen reader text for the +N chip at the end of a row of overlapping profile pictures. It says how many people are not shown.
